subject: Metering units harmonization and reseller pass-through allocation for private offer
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Chris Williams <cwilliams@aldennet.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@aldennet.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Metering unit harmonization and reseller pass-through allocation for private offer

Hi Chris / Alden procurement team —

Thanks for sending over the metering note. We reviewed the pdf you attached (Alden_metering_request.pdf) and have a few follow-ups before we finalize the private offer. Key items we want to align on:

- Mapping: you asked to convert our current node-hour SKU into a vCPU-minute + ephemeral storage metric for AWS and a vCPU-minute + disk-GiB-month metric for GCP. We can provide a deterministic mapping but need to agree on rounding rules and minimums.
- Billing cadence: will Alden accept a single consolidated monthly charge (Redwood invoice) with a separate reseller pass-through line so your reseller can see their margin? Or do you need raw SKU line items split per cloud region?
- Channel margin: we typically allow reseller pass-through as either a percent-of-list or a fixed per-unit offset. For this PO we need an explicit instruction so Finance can set the invoice template and tax handling.

I've attached a first-draft mapping (proposed-mapping.xlsx) to show the equivalence we typically use for conversions and the two pass-through presentation options. Can you confirm: 1) preferred meter presentation (consolidated vs per-cloud lines) and 2) whether reseller margin should be shown as a separate line (recommended) or netted into the unit price?

If it helps, we can run two sample invoices for May usage so you can validate with your reseller.

Thanks — aiming to have this locked before next week so legal can push the PO to signature.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Strategic Accounts Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Chris Williams <cwilliams@aldennet.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@aldennet.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Metering unit harmonization and reseller pass-through allocation for private offer

Thanks Irene — good summary. A couple clarifications from our side: 

1) Presentation: we prefer a consolidated monthly invoice with a per-cloud breakdown as line items (so we get both the single charge and visibility). That means the invoice should show AWS:GCP:GCP-Regional lines but also a single summary line for total due.
2) Channel margin: our reseller (Vertex Partners) requires the margin to be visible as a separate line (they use that for rebate reconciliation). Please show reseller pass-through as "Partner Commission" with both amount and percent.
3) Rounding: for the vCPU-minute conversion, round up to the nearest 10 vCPU-min to avoid micro-billing volatility. For storage, round to nearest GiB.

We can accept the sample invoices. If you can generate them by end of day Wednesday that would give us time to circulate to Vertex.

—Chris
Procurement Lead | Alden Networks

Ben / Naomi — forwarding Alden's clarifications. Short ask: can Finance & Pricing provide two sample invoice renders (May usage assumption below) showing the two display options, and a recommended per-unit uplift (if any) to preserve reseller economics?

Assumptions for the sample:
- May usage: 4,800 node-hours (current measurement) which we will map to 288,000 vCPU-min under the vCPU-minute model (assume 60 vCPU-min per node-hour average).
- Ephemeral usage: 1.2 TiB total across workloads (map to 1229 GiB-month for billing).
- Reseller commission: Vertex asking for "Partner Commission" line with 7.5% of list revenue.

Deliverables requested by Wednesday EOD:
1) Two invoice layouts (consolidated+breakdown vs per-cloud lines) as PDFs
2) Suggested unit price adjustments or a pass-through line amount so Alden's reseller sees the 7.5% commission without us taking unexpected margin leakage
3) Short note on tax treatment when partner commission is shown as a line vs netted into price (we usually treat as commission expense; flag any material differences)

I can share Alden's PO number once Finance asks for it (ALD-PO-2026-045).

Thanks —
Irene

Irene/Naomi —

Thanks for the clear assumptions. Quick outputs from Pricing/Finance after an initial pass:

1) Invoice layouts: attached are two renders (invoice_consolidated.pdf / invoice_percloud.pdf). WeÃ¢â‚¬â„¢ve followed Alden's request: consolidated summary line plus per-cloud detail.
2) Commission handling: showing a separate "Partner Commission" line is fine. When shown separately we will expense it as a commission (no effect on customer tax liability in the US for the customer-facing gross amount). For internal revenue recognition we net commission as a selling expense.
3) Unit adjustments: to preserve net margin to Redwood and to avoid changing Alden's expected list price bands, we suggest leaving unit prices flat and presenting Partner Commission as a separate calculated line (7.5% of list). This is the least disruptive approach. If Alden requires us to hold list fixed and reduce our listed price, that will require a revenue reprice (not recommended for this PO).

Ben has a legal note: we need a clause that defines partner commission mechanics (display vs netting) and states that the reseller cannot claim a second rebate from Redwood. Suggest loop in Legal for a short addendum.

Naomi, can you produce the two sample PDFs by EOD today so we can send to Alden and Vertex?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
